input: jkbTdScore (0-100 production JKB TD Score, computed with the trailingWindowStrategy window)

optionalTeamChangedTerm.rationale: The base calibrator over-predicts players in their first games with a new team by ~5pp (prior-team role does not transfer). Adding a teamChanged dummy to the CALIBRATOR (not the score) removes it at ~zero cost to everyone else.
optionalTeamChangedTerm.isTeamChanged: 1 if the player's most recent prior game was for a different team than this week's team, else 0
optionalTeamChangedTerm.caveat: c is estimated on ~180 mover player-games/season — re-estimate as seasons accrue.

caveats: No historical sportsbook odds — market edge untested.
Predicted P > 0.5 region has < 25 observations in 2025 — unvalidated; do not extrapolate. Prefer a confidence flag above ~P 0.45 over a hard cap (P 0.40-0.50 is well calibrated).
Weeks 2-4 remain the weakest band even under the recommended strategy (cal slope ~0.93) — see early-season-results.json.
The recommended strategy changes the live default window from season-to-date to 'last 8' — a visible behaviour change that needs its own shadow validation.
